title: Stephen is stoned
summary: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
summary_zh: 众人听见这话就极其恼怒，向司提反咬牙切齿。

title: Saul persecutes the church
summary: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.
summary_zh: 从这日起，耶路撒冷的教会大遭逼迫，除了使徒以外，门徒都分散在犹太和撒马利亚各处。

title: Philip preaches in Samaria
summary: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
summary_zh: 那些分散的人往各处去传道。

title: Conversion of Ethiopian Eunuch
summary: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
summary_zh: 有主的一个使者对腓利说：「起来！向南走，往那从耶路撒冷下迦萨的路上去。」那路是旷野。

title: Saul is converted
summary: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
summary_zh: 扫罗仍然向主的门徒口吐威吓凶煞的话，去见大祭司，

title: Saul proclaims Jesus
summary: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
summary_zh: 就在各会堂里宣传耶稣，说他是神的儿子。

title: Peter heals Aeneas and Dorcas
title_zh: 彼得医治以尼雅，使多加复活
summary: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
summary_zh: 彼得周流四方的时候，也到了居住吕大的圣徒那里；

title: Peter meets Cornelius
summary: There was a certain man in Cesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
summary_zh: 在凯撒利亚有一个人，名叫哥尼流，是「意大利营」的百夫长。

title: Peter preaches to gentiles in Caesarea
title_zh: 彼得在该撒利亚向外邦人传道
summary: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
summary_zh: 彼得就开口说：「我真看出神是不偏待人。

title: Peter defends Gentile salvation
title_zh: 彼得为外邦人得救辩明
summary: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
summary_zh: 使徒和在犹太的众弟兄听说外邦人也领受了神的道。

title: Disciples first called Christians
title_zh: 门徒称为基督徒从安提阿起首
summary: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
summary_zh: 那些因司提反的事遭患难四散的门徒直走到腓尼基和塞浦路斯，并安提阿；他们不向别人讲道，只向犹太人讲。

title: Herod kills James
summary: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
summary_zh: 那时，希律王下手苦害教会中几个人，

title: Herod imprisons Peter
summary: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
summary_zh: 他见犹太人喜欢这事，又去捉拿彼得。那时正是除酵的日子。

title: An angel rescues Peter from prison
summary: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
summary_zh: 希律将要提他出来的前一夜，彼得被两条铁链锁著，睡在两个兵丁当中；看守的人也在门外看守。

title: Herod dies
summary: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king’s country.
summary_zh: 希律恼怒泰尔、西顿的人。他们那一带地方是从王的地土得粮，因此就托了王的内侍臣伯拉斯都的情，一心来求和。

title: First missionary journey begins
summary: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
summary_zh: 神的道日见兴旺，越发广传。

title: First Missionary Journey
summary: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
summary_zh: 神的道日见兴旺，越发广传。

title: Barnabas and Saul go to Cyprus
title_zh: 巴拿巴和扫罗往塞浦路斯
summary: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
summary_zh: 他们既被圣灵差遣，就下到西流基，从那里坐船往塞浦路斯去。

title: Mission to Antioch in Pisidia
title_zh: 在彼西底的安提阿传道
summary: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
summary_zh: 保罗和他的同人从帕弗开船，来到旁非利亚的别加，约翰就离开他们，回耶路撒冷去。

title: Mission to Iconium
summary: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
summary_zh: 二人在以哥念同进犹太人的会堂，在那里讲的，叫犹太人和希腊人信的很多。

title: Mission to Lystra and Derbe
summary: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
summary_zh: 使徒知道了，就逃往吕高尼的路司得、特庇两个城和周围地方去，

title: Return to Antioch in Syria
summary: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
summary_zh: 对那城里的人传了福音，使好些人作门徒，就回路司得、以哥念、安提阿去，

title: Jerusalem Council
summary: And certain men which came down from Judea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
summary_zh: 有几个人从犹太下来，教训弟兄们说：「你们若不按摩西的规条受割礼，不能得救。」

title: Paul and Barnabas part ways
summary: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
summary_zh: 但保罗和巴拿巴仍住在安提阿，和许多别人一同教训人，传主的道。

title: Second Missionary Journey begins
summary: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
summary_zh: 保罗拣选了西拉，也出去，蒙弟兄们把他交于主的恩中。

title: Timothy Joins Paul and Silas
title_zh: 提摩太加入保罗和西拉
summary: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:
summary_zh: 保罗来到特庇，又到路司得。在那里有一个门徒，名叫提摩太，是信主之犹太妇人的儿子，他父亲却是希腊人。

title: Mission to Phrygia, Galatia and Asia
title_zh: 在弗吕家、加拉太和亚细亚传道
summary: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,
summary_zh: 圣灵既然禁止他们在亚细亚讲道，他们就经过弗吕家、加拉太一带地方。

title: Call to Macedonia
summary: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
summary_zh: 在夜间有异象现与保罗。有一个马其顿人站著求他说：「请你过到马其顿来帮助我们。」

title: Lydia's Conversion
summary: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.
summary_zh: 当安息日，我们出城门，到了河边，知道那里有一个祷告的地方，我们就坐下对那聚会的妇女讲道。

title: Paul casts demon out of soothsayer
title_zh: 保罗赶出使女身上的巫鬼
summary: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:
summary_zh: 后来，我们往那祷告的地方去。有一个使女迎著面来，她被巫鬼所附，用法术，叫她主人们大得财利。

title: Paul and Silas imprisoned
summary: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,
summary_zh: 使女的主人们见得利的指望没有了，便揪住保罗和西拉，拉他们到市上去见首领；

title: Philippian jailer converted
summary: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
summary_zh: 约在半夜，保罗和西拉祷告，唱诗赞美神，众囚犯也侧耳而听。

title: Paul and Silas released
summary: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
summary_zh: 到了天亮，官长打发差役来，说：「释放那两个人吧。」

title: Uproar in Thessalonica
summary: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
summary_zh: 保罗和西拉经过暗妃坡里、亚波罗尼亚，来到帖撒罗尼迦，在那里有犹太人的会堂。

title: Mission to Berea
summary: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
summary_zh: 弟兄们随即在夜间打发保罗和西拉往庇哩亚去。二人到了，就进入犹太人的会堂。

title: Paul preaches in Athens
summary: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
summary_zh: 保罗在雅典等候他们的时候，看见满城都是偶像，就心里著急；

title: Mission to Corinth, 1&2 Thess Written
title_zh: 在哥林多传道，写帖撒罗尼迦前后书
summary: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;
summary_zh: 这事以后，保罗离了雅典，来到哥林多。

title: Return from Second Missionary Journey
summary: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.
summary_zh: 保罗又住了多日，就辞别了弟兄，坐船往叙利亚去；百基拉、亚居拉和他同去。他因为许过愿，就在坚革哩剪了头发。

title: Third Missionary Journey Begins
summary: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.
summary_zh: 有一个犹太人，名叫亚波罗，来到以弗所。他生在亚历山大，是有学问（或译：口才）的，最能讲解圣经。

title: Mission to Ephesus/1 Cor Written
title_zh: 在以弗所传道，写哥林多前书
summary: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,
summary_zh: 亚波罗在哥林多的时候，保罗经过了上边一带地方，就来到以弗所；在那里遇见几个门徒，

title: Riot in Ephesus
summary: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.
summary_zh: 那时，因为这道起的扰乱不小。

title: Mission to Macedonia and Greece
summary: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.
summary_zh: 乱定之后，保罗请门徒来，劝勉他们，就辞别起行，往马其顿去。

title: Eutychus revived
summary: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.
summary_zh: 七日的第一日，我们聚会擘饼的时候，保罗因为要次日起行，就与他们讲论，直讲到半夜。

title: Voyage to Miletus
summary: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.
summary_zh: 我们先上船，开往亚朔去，意思要在那里接保罗；因为他是这样安排的，他自己打算要步行。

title: Paul speaks to Ephesian Elders
title_zh: 保罗对以弗所长老讲话
summary: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.
summary_zh: 保罗从米利都打发人往以弗所去，请教会的长老来。

title: Voyage from Miletus to Jerusalem
title_zh: 从米利都航往耶路撒冷
summary: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:
summary_zh: 我们离别了众人，就开船一直行到哥士。第二天到了罗底，从那里到帕大喇，

title: Paul visits elders in Jerusalem
title_zh: 保罗在耶路撒冷见众长老
summary: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.
summary_zh: 第二天，保罗同我们去见雅各；长老们也都在那里。

title: Paul arrested in the Temple
summary: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,
summary_zh: 那七日将完，从亚细亚来的犹太人看见保罗在殿里，就耸动了众人，下手拿他，

title: Paul gives his testimony
summary: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?
summary_zh: 将要带他进营楼，保罗对千夫长说：「我对你说句话可以不可以？」他说：「你懂得希腊话吗？

title: Paul goes before the Council
summary: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.
summary_zh: 第二天，千夫长为要知道犹太人控告保罗的实情，便解开他，吩咐祭司长和全公会的人都聚集，将保罗带下来，叫他站在他们面前。

title: The conspiracy to kill Paul
summary: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.
summary_zh: 到了天亮，犹太人同谋起誓，说：「若不先杀保罗就不吃不喝。」

title: Paul sent to Felix
title_zh: 保罗被解到腓力斯那里
summary: And he called unto him two centurions, saying, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Cesarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night;
summary_zh: 千夫长便叫了两个百夫长来，说：「预备步兵二百，马兵七十，长枪手二百，今夜亥初往凯撒利亚去；

title: Paul appeals to Caesar
summary: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Cesarea to Jerusalem.
summary_zh: 非斯都到了任，过了三天，就从凯撒利亚上耶路撒冷去。

title: Agrippa and Bernice meet Festus
title_zh: 亚基帕与百尼基见非斯都
summary: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Cesarea to salute Festus.
summary_zh: 过了些日子，亚基帕王和百妮基氏来到凯撒利亚，问非斯都安。

title: Paul goes before Agrippa
title_zh: 保罗在亚基帕面前申诉
summary: Then Agrippa said unto Festus, I would also hear the man myself. To morrow, said he, thou shalt hear him.
summary_zh: 亚基帕对非斯都说：「我自己也愿听这人辩论。」非斯都说：「明天你可以听。」

title: Journey to Rome begins
summary: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus’ band.
summary_zh: 非斯都既然定规了，叫我们坐船往意大利去，便将保罗和别的囚犯交给御营里的一个百夫长，名叫犹流。

title: Paul's Journey to Rome
summary: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus’ band.
summary_zh: 非斯都既然定规了，叫我们坐船往意大利去，便将保罗和别的囚犯交给御营里的一个百夫长，名叫犹流。

title: Paul is shipwrecked by a storm
summary: And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, loosing thence, they sailed close by Crete.
summary_zh: 这时，微微起了南风，他们以为得意，就起了锚，贴近克里特行去。

title: Paul stays at Malta
summary: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.
summary_zh: 我们既已得救，才知道那岛名叫马耳他。

title: Paul arrives at Rome
summary: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.
summary_zh: 过了三个月，我们上了亚历山大的船往前行；这船以「宙斯双子」为记，是在那海岛过了冬的。

title: Paul's First Roman imprisonment
title_zh: 保罗第一次在罗马被囚
summary: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, ye…
summary_zh: 过了三天，保罗请犹太人的首领来。他们来了，就对他们说：「弟兄们，我虽没有做甚么事干犯本国的百姓和我们祖宗的规条，却被锁绑，从耶路撒冷解在罗马人的手里。
